title: Find by ID
summary: An ID should identify one page element. Selenium can use it to find a control.
introduction: An ID should identify one page element. Selenium can use it to find a control. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An ID should identify one page element. Selenium can use it to find a control.

blocks.code:
from urllib.parse import quote
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By

driver = webdriver.Chrome()
try:
    driver.get("data:text/html;charset=utf-8," + quote('<button id="save">Save</button>'))
    assert driver.find_element(By.ID, "save").text == "Save"
finally:
    driver.quit()
blocks.title: Find by ID

blocks.text: The check reads the Save button.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Change the ID in both the page and locator.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Two elements should not share the same ID.
